title: Bank Deposit Delivery Times, Cut-Offs, Weekend Payout and the On-Time Promise by Tier
content:
How quickly a Bank Deposit transfer becomes available to the recipient depends on the tier: its delivery time in Paloma business days, its daily booking cut-off in US Central time, whether it pays out on weekends and US Federal Reserve holidays, whether it carries Paloma's on-time promise, and how many times a payout that fails for a technical reason is retried.

## Timing schedule

| Tier | Delivery time (Paloma business days from release) | Booking cut-off (US Central) | Weekend and holiday payout | On-time promise | Automatic retries of a technically failed payout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 3 | 15:00 | no | yes | 2 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 1 | 15:00 | no | yes | 2 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 0 (same day as release) | 24x7 | yes | yes | 3 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | 0 (same day as release) | 24x7 | yes | yes | 3 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 1 | 13:00 | no | yes | 2 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 2 | 14:00 | no | no | 1 |

## Definitions

- **Delivery time.** Paloma business days from release to the disclosed date of availability; 0 means the same day as release.
- **Booking cut-off.** The latest US Central time on a business day for a release to count from that day; a later release counts from the next business day. The real-time tiers run 24x7.
- **Weekend and holiday payout.** Whether payouts are made on Saturdays, Sundays and US Federal Reserve holidays.
- **On-time promise.** Whether Paloma refunds the transfer fee when a transfer reaches the recipient after its disclosed date of availability for a reason on Paloma's side.
- **Automatic retries.** How many times a payout that fails for a technical reason is retried before it is treated as returned.

## Notes on the table

- Bank Deposit International Wire is the only tier without the on-time promise.
- The two real-time tiers (Express and Express Plus) are the only tiers with 24x7 booking, weekend payout and a same-day delivery time.
- Bank Deposit Large Amount has the earliest cut-off, 13:00.
